clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers from both factions reach Mystral Lake in south-central Ashenvale. Its deep waters draw them beneath the watch of the night elves.

Mystral Lake draws travelers to its shores in southern Ashenvale. The vast lake lies south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, the largest lake in the forest. Night elves keep watch from their outpost on its northern shore. Travelers from both the Horde and the Alliance often find their journeys bringing them to its banks.

Horde shaman come to Mystral Lake during trials of elemental communion. In its deep waters, they seek to understand the element of water. The lake’s raw primal resonance makes it an essential pilgrimage site for those learning to bind and respect the tidal spirits.
